description: Population and Electricity Supply Statistics is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents key annual summary statistics on population and electricity in Qatar. It includes figures on population size and growth rate alongside total electricity generation, energy transmitted, net electricity distributed, and household electricity consumption excluding bulk industrial use. The data supports analysis of energy demand trends in relation to demographic changes. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, consumption, population, Growth. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
